# vp9-conformance.txt - the libvpx VP9 test vectors in FFmpeg's fate-suite
# (vp9-test-vectors/, profile 0 and the profile 2 10-bit 4:2:0 vector),
# remuxed to IVF with `ffmpeg -i NAME.webm -c copy -f ivf NAME.ivf`
# (-copyinkf for vp90-2-16-intra-only, which starts with intra-only frames),
# with FFmpeg 6.1.1's output: every frame at its own size (-autoscale 0),
# yuv420p, or yuv420p10le for 10 bit, as vdpu383test writes it.
# One output frame per decoded shown frame (-fps_mode passthrough). The
# first set (2026-11-25) was made without it: IVF timestamps are in 1/1000 s,
# FFmpeg's rawvideo output is constant frame rate by default and repeated
# each frame to fill the gaps (vp90-2-00-quantizer-30: 34 frames for 2), so
# 67 streams whose every frame matched showed MISMATCH on the board.
#
